# Shadowthewuff

> Personal link-in-bio page for Tanner "shadowdewuff" Knapp, built on a fork of LittleLink.

Links out to profiles on VRChat, Steam, Last.fm, AniList, Tracker Network, Medal.tv, TikTok and Toyhouse. No account system, no content beyond the link list and the legal pages below.

## Pages

- [Home](https://me.shadowdewuff.gay/): the link list
- [Privacy Policy](https://me.shadowdewuff.gay/privacy): data collection, cookies, and the diagnostics API
- [Terms of Service](https://me.shadowdewuff.gay/tos): terms of use
- [Impressum](https://me.shadowdewuff.gay/impressum): legal notice

## Notes

This site's preference on AI training use of its content is stated in /ai.txt: indexing and citation are fine, bulk scraping for model training is not.
